name: Transient Path Integral
definition: The transient path integral models the intensity $I$ recorded by a virtual sensor by integrating over all light paths $ ar{ ar{x}}$ and temporal delays $ ar{ ar{t}}$, accounting for finite light propagation time.
summary: Transient path integral models light intensity by integrating over geometric paths and temporal delays, explicitly accounting for finite light propagation time to simulate time-of-flight phenomena.
